arabic text: KEHTI THI ZAINAB AY MERE SHEYRO, KEHTI THI\nZAINAB, MERE DILERO
english translation text: Zainab would repeatedly say: O my lions,\nO my brave sons—
My Aun and Muhammad, my Aun and Muhammad

arabic text:
KHWAAB YE ZAINAB KA THA, CHAAND SITARE MERE
(CHAAND SITARE) MAMU PE HOGAYE FIDA, GOD KE
PALE MERE (GOD KE PALE)
KHWAAB YE SACHA HUWA, SAR MERE UNCHA RAHA,
HONE KO SHEH PAR FIDA LAAL MERE, SHEYR MERE
CHAAND MERE
english translation text:
This was Zainab’s dream: my moons and stars,
(my moons and stars), raised in my lap,
were sacrificed for their uncle.
(Raised in my lap.)
That dream came true, and my head remained held high.
My sons, my lions, my moons, were ready to be sacrificed for the Master.

arabic text:
JAFFAR-E-TAYYAR KE KHUN KE AKKAS HO (KHUN KE
AKKAS)
HUSN MEI AKBAR HO TUM JOSH MEI ABBAS HO (JOSH
MEI ABBAS)
JANG KE MAYDAAN MEI MAUT KE ARMAAN MEI, SAYA-E-
QUR'AN MEI, AISE UTHO AISE PARO MAUT PE TUM QUD
PARO
english translation text:
You reflect the blood of Jafar al-Tayyar,
(the reflection of his blood).
In beauty you are Akbar; in courage you are Abbas.
(In courage, Abbas.)
In the battlefield,
longing for martyrdom beneath the shade of the Qur’an,
rise and charge so fiercely that you throw yourselves upon death.

arabic text:
HA MERI TAFEED PAR DHYAN TUMHARA RAHO,
(DHYAAN TUMHARA) JAKE LAB-E-NEHR BHI PYAAS
GAWARA RAHE (PYAAS GAWARA)
DUD NA BAKSHUNGI MEI, MU BHI NA DEKHUNGI MEI,
SHEYR KI BETI HU MEI, WADA KARO AAO CHALO, TUM
NA RAHO
english translation text:
Keep my instruction firmly in mind,
(keep it firmly in mind): even at the riverbank, accept your thirst.
(Accept your thirst.)
I will not forgive the milk I fed you, nor look upon your faces,
for I am the daughter of a lion.
Promise me, now go—do not remain behind.

arabic text:
MAANA KE PYAASE HO TUM, PYAAS PE KABU RAHE
(PYAAS PE KAABU)
SHEH KE ALAMDAR KI, SAANS MEI KHUSHBU RAHE
(SAANS MEI KHUSHBU)
BAS YE TAMANNA MERI, LAAJ RAHE KHUN KI, HAI YE
english translation text:
Though you are thirsty, remain masters of your thirst.
(Masters of your thirst.)
Let the fragrance of the Master’s standard-bearer remain in your breath.
(In your breath.)
This alone is my wish: preserve the honour of your blood; this is—

arabic text: WASIYAT MERI, KHAWO QASAM, JAAWO HASHAM,\nHOGA NA KAM
english translation text: —my final instruction. Swear your oath, go with dignity;\nyour courage must never fall short.

arabic text:
AUN YE KEHNA LAGA, BHAAYI MUHAMMAD SUNO
(BHAAYI MUHAMMAD)
EIK TARAF MEI BARO, EIK TARAF TUM BARHO (EIK
TARAF TUM)
JANG HO FOWJ-E-SITAM, JANG KARE AISE HAM, MAAMU
HAME DE ALAM, DEKE HAME AMMA KAHE JITE RAHE
english translation text:
Aun said: Brother Muhammad, listen.
(Brother Muhammad.)
I will advance from one side, and you from the other.
(You from the other side.)
We will fight the army of tyranny together; may our uncle give us the standard,
and when he does, may Mother bless us and say: go forth victorious.

arabic text:
DONO JARI JANG KO SURAT-E-ANDHI BARE, (SURAT-
E-ANDHI)
NANA ALI KI TARHA, MAUT PE HAVI RAHE (MAUT PE
HAVI)
MILKE JO HAMLA KIYA, MEYMANA-O-MESRA, EIK ME
DAM HOGAYA, TEYGH-E-ALI, AISE CHALI, DHUM MACHI
english translation text:
The two warriors charged like a raging storm.
(Like a raging storm.)
Like their grandfather Ali, they overcame death itself.
(Overcame death.)
Together they attacked the right and left wings, crushing them in one blow;
Ali’s sword seemed to move again, and uproar filled the field.

arabic text:
DEKH RAHI THI JO MAA KHAYME KE DARPAR KHARI,
(KHAYME KE DAR PAR)
SAATH WAHI THE KHARE HAZRAT-E-ABBAS BHI,
(HAZRAT-E-ABBAS)
BHAAYI BEHEN SAATH THE, SAHIB-E-AWLAAD THE,
WARIS-E-AJDAAD THE, KEHNE LAGE KHUB LARE SHEYR
MERE
english translation text:
Their mother watched, standing at the tent’s entrance.
(At the tent’s entrance.)
Hazrat Abbas stood there beside her.
(Hazrat Abbas.)
Brother and sister stood together,
both parents and heirs of noble ancestors.
They said: How magnificently my lions have fought.

arabic text:
LARTE KAHA TAK BHALA PYAAS KE MAARE HUWE
(PYAAS KE MARE)
JALTI HUWI KHAAK PAR DONO TARAPNE LAGA (DONO
TARAPNE)
BHAAYI SE KEHNE LAGI, FAKHR SE BINT-E-ALI,
SURKHRU ZAINAB HUWI, SAR PE TERE BHAAYI MERE,
LAAL HUWE
english translation text:
How long could they fight, exhausted by thirst?
(Exhausted by thirst.)
Upon the burning sand, both began to writhe in pain.
(Both began to writhe.)
Proudly the daughter of Ali said to her brother: O my brother,
Zainab has been honoured;
my sons have been sacrificed before you.

arabic text: AUN-O-MUHAMMAD NA THE, WO DUR-E-NAYAAB THE\n(WO DUR-E-NAYAAB)
english translation text: Aun and Muhammad were no ordinary children; they were priceless pearls.\n(Priceless pearls.)

arabic text:
"SARWAR-O-REHAN" WO WAKIF-E-ADAB THE (WAKIF-E-
ADAB)
HUKM JO MAA NE DIYA RUKH NA KIYA NEHR KA, PYAAS
KA SADMA SAHA, MAA NE KAHA SHUKHR-E-KHUDA,
HUWE FIDA
english translation text:
‘Sarwar and Rehan’ say they knew the highest manners.
(Knew the highest manners.)
They obeyed their mother and did not turn toward the river.
They endured the agony of thirst, and their mother thanked God
that they had been sacrificed.
(My Aun and Muhammad, my Aun and Muhammad)
